decisions.reason: After several years without visible continuation, this close-to-core but peripheral Magento template likely fell below aspiration relative to the firm's stronger hosting and support offers, so resources are better redeployed.

A responsive website template is adjacent to the business but not central to the firm's recurring-service model, and its disappearance from view after launch suggests results did not justify continued attention.

Premium customer support fits the firm's main value proposition so closely that even if it is no longer highlighted separately, management would expect it to meet aspiration or be absorbed into the core offer rather than be abandoned.

The software version management tool builds on internal technical capabilities and complements managed hosting, so boundedly rational management would still retain it unless clearer evidence of persistent shortfall emerged.

Because the data-processing-contract tool is distant from the firm's core and has not remained visible, it is the strongest candidate for problemistic search and withdrawal once early slack is exhausted.

Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship, highly aligned with the firm's strategic direction and growing market, so management would continue backing it absent clear signs that it misses aspiration.
